provenance.note: Explicit AOI (min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat) EPSG:4326 - the stretch of the water body the column is solved over [supplied on this invocation]
Epilimnion (warm surface layer) temperature - a PRESCRIBED demo column, since no met-forcing fetcher exists yet [supplied on this invocation]
Hypolimnion (cold bottom layer) temperature; the initial top-to-bottom difference is what the run either keeps or mixes away [supplied on this invocation]
Depth of the thermocline below the surface. The vertical grid is planned to HOLD it and REFUSES when no admissible sigma stretch over the basin's deepest column can [supplied on this invocation]

Sustained wind speed; 0 is CALM - the half of the pair in which the thermocline persists - and a nonzero value both mixes the column and drives the surface-downwind / return-flow-at-depth circulation reported beside the temperature [supplied on this invocation]
Compass bearing the wind blows FROM (0=N, 90=E, 270=W) [supplied on this invocation]

Number of vertical sigma levels - the degree of freedom a 2D model does not have, so it is THE resolution lever here; too few for the declared thermocline is a refusal, not a coarser answer [supplied on this invocation]
Triangle edge the basin interior is meshed at; the 3D node count is this mesh's nodes times the sigma levels [supplied on this invocation]
Simulated duration - long enough for the column to settle or mix [supplied on this invocation]
Solve sizing class [supplied on this invocation]

SCHEME FOR ADVECTION OF TRACERS - the NERD family (13, 14), which is the distributive scheme the iteration ceiling below governs and the only one that is monotone across a thermocline. 13 is the value the engine's own telemac2d dictionary defaults this same keyword to; the dictionary gives the 3D one no default at all, so unstated it falls back to the VELOCITIES scheme (5, MURD PSI), which is what stopped a baroclinic basin at its first tracer step [declared constant default]

MAXIMUM NUMBER OF ITERATIONS FOR ADVECTION SCHEMES - the ceiling the distributive schemes 13 and 14 sub-iterate under. Stated rather than defaulted because it is the number a run that stops on 'ITERATION NO. REACHED' is bounded by, and a reader of the deck cannot see a ceiling the deck does not write [declared constant default]
not supplied; the lake level is the most recent reading the gauge has published today

not supplied; the step follows the edge the ACCEPTED mesh was BUILT at, through the same CFL producer the river reach's step comes from - a step asserted independently of the mesh is a stability claim about a domain nobody measured
not supplied; the deck writes a frame every solver step block
